---
title: Utilities to simplify analyzing a corpus
---


## Analyzing a corpus

If you want to analyze an entire corpus that you have in a CEX-format file, use`analyze_ctsdata_to_files.py`

```sh
python utilities/analyze_ctsdata_to_files.py corpus.cex 
     --output-dir analyses/
```

## Working with part of a corpus

`group_ctsdata_by_sentence.py`: get URNs grouped by sentences. Does not require LM.

`tokenize_ctsdata.py`: get a table of tokens with stable ids for a specific version (edition/translation) of a text. Does not require LM.
